title: RS-25 Engine Tests at NASA Stennis
text:
Teams at NASA’s Stennis Space Center near Bay St. Louis, Mississippi tested RS-25 engine No. 10001 on Oct. 21, 2026. The hot fire test lasted for almost eight-and-a-half minutes (500 seconds), the same amount of time RS-25 engines fire during launch of NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket, with a 111% power level. For each Artemis mission, four RS-25 engines produce up to 2 million pounds of combined thrust to help launch the SLS rocket.

Prior to use, all RS-25 engines are proven flightworthy at NASA Stennis. While this developmental engine will not be used in flight, the hot fire test provides NASA and NASA’s prime engine contractor L3Harris Technologies with the capability to capture critical data to improve engine performance and reliability.

Image credit: NASA/Danny Nowlin

zhTitle: NASA 斯坦尼斯的 RS-25 引擎測試
zh:
美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）位於密西西比州貝聖路易斯附近的斯坦尼斯太空中心團隊，於2026年10月21日對RS-25引擎編號10001進行了測試。熱火測試持續了將近八分半鐘（500秒），這與NASA SLS（太空發射系統）火箭發射時RS-25引擎的點火時間相同，功率水平達到111%。每次Artemis任務中，四台RS-25引擎可產生高達200萬磅的總推力，協助發射SLS火箭。

在使用前，所有RS-25引擎都需在NASA斯坦尼斯中心證明具備飛行能力。雖然這款開發中的引擎不會用於實際飛行，但熱火測試讓NASA及其主要引擎承包商L3Harris Technologies能夠獲取關鍵數據，以提升引擎性能和可靠性。

圖片來源：NASA/Danny Nowlin
